rules.title: Window days validation
rules.statement: Raise exception LMS-031 if p_window_days is NULL or outside 1-90 inclusive.

rules.title: Skip NPA classification
rules.statement: Increment p_skipped and skip loan if asset_class equals 'NPA'.

rules.title: Missing benchmark error
rules.statement: Raise exception LMS-005 if benchmark_code is NULL on a floating loan.

rules.title: Next reset cycle calculation
rules.statement: Compute v_months as complete reset_months cycles since disb_date, then set v_next to disb_date plus that many months.
rules.notes: Uses extract(year/month from age); no rounding function called.

rules.title: Reset outside window skip
rules.statement: Skip loan if v_next exceeds p_as_of plus p_window_days.

rules.title: Notice date weekend adjustment
rules.statement: Set v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday, plus 1 day if Sunday, else v_next.
rules.notes: Only Saturday (6) and Sunday (0) handled; no other holidays.

rules.title: New rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_new equals most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct on or before v_next (or 0 if none) plus spread_pct (coalesced to 0).
rules.notes: numeric columns, coalesce to 0 for missing benchmark or spread.

rules.title: Old rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_old equals most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct on or before prior cycle start (or 0 if none) plus spread_pct (coalesced to 0).
rules.notes: numeric columns, coalesce to 0 for missing benchmark or spread.

rules.title: Minimum rate change threshold
rules.statement: Skip and increment p_skipped if absolute difference between v_new and v_old is less than 0.25.
rules.notes: Hard-coded 0.25 threshold; no rounding applied to rates.

rules.title: Duplicate notice suppression
rules.statement: Skip and increment p_skipped if a RESET_NOTICE entry already exists whose note starts with 'reset ' followed by v_next.
rules.notes: Uses LIKE pattern on note column.

rules.title: Insert reset notice
rules.statement: Insert loan_ledger row with entry_type RESET_NOTICE, amount = v_new, entry_date = v_notice, and note containing old and new rates.

open_questions: Confirm that only Saturdays and Sundays are shifted for notice date and that no other holiday calendar is intended.
Confirm that rate lookups default missing benchmark or spread to exactly 0 rather than raising an error.
Confirm that duplicate detection relies solely on the constructed note string rather than a dedicated flag column.
